blocks.text: Muscle is defined as the tissue that can contract in a coordinated way to produce movements of body parts or whole body. The individual cells of muscle are called muscle fibres or myofibres.
Muscles’ ability to contract and relax not only enables the body to move, but also provides the force that pushes substances, such as blood and food, through the body.
